title: Functoriality of Ext as Yoneda composition with morphisms
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme, with Ext as in [def-sc-ext-sheaf] and Yoneda composition of Ext classes as in [lem-sc-p1-ext-yoneda-associativity], a morphism of $\mathcal O_X$-modules being an element of $\operatorname{Ext}^0_X=\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathcal O_X}$. Let $i\geq0$, $e\in\operatorname{Ext}^i_X(\mathcal F,\mathcal G)$, and let $u:\mathcal F'\to\mathcal F$ and $\varphi:\mathcal G\to\mathcal G'$ be morphisms of $\mathcal O_X$-modules. Then $\operatorname{Ext}^i_X(u,\mathcal G)(e)=e\circ u$ and $\operatorname{Ext}^i_X(\mathcal F,\varphi)(e)=\varphi[i]\circ e$. Moreover the identification $\operatorname{Ext}^i_X(\mathcal O_X,\mathcal G)=H^i(X,\mathcal G)$ of [lem-sc-ext-locally-free] is natural in $\mathcal G$: under it, $\operatorname{Ext}^i_X(\mathcal O_X,\varphi)$ is $H^i(\varphi)$ of [def-sc-sheaf-cohomology-functor]; in particular $H^i(\varphi)(x)=\varphi[i]\circ x$ for $x\in H^i(X,\mathcal G)$.

proof.text: Read the Ext groups through the corrected derived-category/injective-resolution interpretation of [lem-weil-pbc-ext-via-injective-resolution]. The derived-category definition and its functorial maps are stated in [def-pc-ext]: for $u:\mathcal F'\to\mathcal F$ the map is precomposition by $Q(u[0])$, while for $\varphi:\mathcal G\to\mathcal G'$ it is postcomposition by $Q(\varphi[0])[i]$. Therefore a class $e$ has images $e\circ u$ and $\varphi[i]\circ e$.

The Yoneda product agrees with the shifted derived-category composite by [lem-sc-ext-yoneda-composition-derived]. Its degree-zero cases give the two displayed formulas, and the operation is the Yoneda composition named in [lem-sc-p1-ext-yoneda-associativity].

Specialize [lem-sc-ext-locally-free-second-naturality] to $\mathcal F=\mathcal O_X$. Its canonical isomorphism becomes $\operatorname{Ext}^i_X(\mathcal O_X,\mathcal G)=H^i(X,\mathcal G)$ by [lem-sc-ext-locally-free], and the induced map is $H^i(\varphi)$ by [def-sc-sheaf-cohomology-functor]. Thus $H^i(\varphi)(x)=\varphi[i]\circ x$.
